newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lapeyre shares up sharply on 96 results.
newsitem.headline: Lapeyre shares up sharply on 96 results.

text.p: Shares in building materials group Lapeyre rose sharply on Thursday after it announced a 12 percent increase in net attributable profits in 1996, above market expectations, traders said.
At 1115 GMT, Lapeyre shares were up 7.98 percent at 352.0 francs with 38,175 shares traded. They hit a high of 355.0 earlier in the session, above the previous high for the year of 340 francs.
"Profits were higher than the consensus, the company presented a favourable outlook in a morose housing market. That was enough the share, which was undervalued, to take off," a trader said.
